# deps: tools: up esbuild to v0.15.0

Pin `esbuild` at v0.15.0 in the Go toolset, following [[DOT-377]] (v0.14.54) — a minor-version step. `esbuild` is a JS bundler kept in the toolset; the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin. The release notes are the [v0.15.0 tag](https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.15.0).
